scope: Bound exact Preview deployment readiness waiting without weakening identity validation; preserve verified source, Google evidence and browser builder cost limitations.
riskAnalysis: Shared CI identity pinning can incorrectly fail before the application build is ready. Longer waiting must remain bounded, fail closed, abort hung requests and never accept stale or substituted releases.

threatModel.assets: Exact Preview source/deployment fingerprint, sanitized CI evidence, protection credentials and reliable mandatory Browser QA.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Read-only authenticated alias/immutable identity responses to existing validation, then bounded waiting to evidence artifact and CI environment output.
threatModel.abuseCases: Old aliases, wrong branch/project/source, changed immutable identity, hung fetch or JSON body, late completion and unbounded retries.
threatModel.mitigations: Unchanged pin/validate/pair/equivalent guards;fixed120attempts/ten-minute deadline,per-request10seconds,abortable pause,late-result isolation and sanitized finite errors. No additional credentials or mutation.

rollback: Revert the waiting helper and its tests to the earlier fail-closed polling while retaining valid current source and evidence; never bypass exact Preview identity checks.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Existing actual pin validation rejects malformed identity and sanitized errors; no response is accepted without exact immutable match.
negativePaths.stale-state: Actual pin tests preserve source ancestry, branch, release, project and immutable deployment checks.
negativePaths.concurrency: Single sequential read-only attempt loop;late completions cannot supply evidence or schedule another attempt.
negativePaths.cancellation: Whole deadline aborts fetch and pause;max120attempts and existing25minute workflow timeout remain.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker or paid dispatch is created;interrupted CI has no successful artifact or execution authority.
negativePaths.api-outage: Hung fetch/body ends at deadline;HTTP and transport failures remain sanitized and fail closed.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Existing protection secret requirement unchanged;no denied identity can become a successful pin.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Only bounded existing read-only identity GETs;no model requests, reservations, infrastructure activation or new recurring workload.
negativePaths.partial-execution: No GITHUB_ENV target is written until exact verification succeeds;late completion cannot overwrite the returned result.

defects.rootCause: Old36attempt polling exhausted before two observed exact Preview builds became READY.
defects.detectionGap: Correct fail-closed identity check had a readiness window shorter than the observed deployment build.
defects.regression: Eight independent offline wait tests plus original identity tests cover delayed success,hung fetch/body,abort and late completion.
defects.historicalPrevention: Preserve failed run evidence;measure a future first-attempt deployment check without cancelling current valid Browser QA.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend only existing pin script, no new gateway,release mechanism,credentials or orchestration.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing Node AbortController,AbortSignal and fixed identity endpoint;no package changes.
proactiveReview.threats: Longer readiness cannot permit older or substituted release,unsanitized diagnostics or unbounded requests.
proactiveReview.failureModes: All mismatches fail closed;shared asynchronous deadline and existing job timeout bound pending work.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Independent8/8 tests passed;combined17/17 actual pin and wait tests passed1574.0256ms after final timer ordering.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent Work QA and Engineering Auditor reviewed actual diff;no material finding conditional on STRICT and hosted verification.
proactiveReview.recovery: Wait for current1f6 Browser run before publishing to avoid concurrency cancellation;retain all old failed attempts.
proactiveReview.readiness: Candidate only;required STRICT and final hosted verification pending. Browser infrastructure remains unavailable and all paid/count execution disabled.
